why: BLK-PA18: widen the Krasnov contrast from a single Ru point and one model-class pair to 5 metals x {D-MPNN, LightGBM, XGBoost} on each metal's own paper-funnel cohort and DOI folds, so the cross-cohort gap is attributable to cohort scope rather than model capability.
honest_framing_note: MEASURED only.  The D-MPNN column is merged from --dmpnn-json when supplied and otherwise recorded as absent.  Krasnov published only Ru and Ir; the other three metals have no external reference.  The classification metrics are computed at a FIXED threshold (0.5); they are not threshold-tuned, and the AUC axis remains the primary (threshold-free) metric.  PR-AUC (average precision) is added because the label is imbalanced (active_rate 0.31-0.53).  Calibration (ECE + reliability bins) is computed on the POOLED out-of-fold probabilities across the 10 folds — each molecule appears once, scored by the model that did not train on it.  The applicability domain is a fixed Tanimoto cut (0.4) to the fold's training set; out-of-AD AUC is reported only for folds whose out-of-AD slice contains both classes (else omitted, never fabricated).
